label: Stabbing weapons tier list, part 1

items.verdict: worst base damage, but stockpile non-magical ones for throwers lacking a returning weapon
identical to the shortsword but trades piercing strike for the weaker lacerate
best non-magical light finesse weapon; you dual-wield two before magic ones appear
only useful if merchant rolls left you without a +1 shortsword or scimitar
basically identical to the +1 shortsword; buy whichever a merchant rolls first
barely better than a +1 scimitar; the mould is far better spent on armour
guaranteed early +1 dagger, but extra necrotic on sleeping enemies is nearly irrelevant
BUGGED to apply ruptured on every hit, pass or fail; fun condition alternative
+2 shortsword; wider crit range, damage-dice rerolls, advantage in darkness; stat stick for anyone
one turn of bless conflicts with the party's other bless sources and costs enhancement
extra d8 versus full-health targets, doubled on crits; huge for assassins and fast characters
momentum arrives only after you have already closed; quickly replaced by +1 weapons
an ordinary +1 shortsword, but GUARANTEED IN THE BLIGHTED VILLAGE instead of a merchant roll
silence shuts down casters and honour-mode legendary actions; A not S because encounter-specific swap
always +1; becomes a +2 bane-applying blade when bound as a pact or bound weapon
goblins attack the wielder at disadvantage; underrated off-hand for squishy characters in goblin fights

unassigned.why: Shortsword +1 is discussed and called the best of the three +1 versions, but NO LETTER IS EVER SPOKEN for it; the neighbouring A tier belongs to Scimitar +1. Not a stray verdict, so it is excluded from verdicts_in_transcript.
